sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西。

sentences.en: Almost immediately after Israel was attacked on October 7th, it began preparing for a ground invasion of Gaza.
sentences.zh: 在10月7日以色列遇袭后，几乎立即就开始为对加沙的地面入侵做准备。

sentences.en: But more than two weeks later, that invasion hasn't happened.
sentences.zh: 但两周多过去了，那次入侵仍未发生。

sentences.en: Today, I talked to Jerusalem Bureau Chief Patrick Kingsley about why.
sentences.zh: 今天，我与耶路撒冷分社社长帕特里克·金斯利谈了谈原因。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, October 25th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月25日，星期三。

sentences.en: So Patrick, it's 6.30 in the evening in New York and it's 1.30 in the morning where you are in Israel.
sentences.zh: 帕特里克，现在是纽约时间晚上6点半，你所在的以色列是凌晨1点半。

sentences.en: We know you've had a really long day.
sentences.zh: 我们知道你度过了非常漫长的一天。

sentences.en: Tell us where we're reaching you right now and what you've been doing.
sentences.zh: 告诉我们你现在在哪里，以及你一直在做什么。

sentences.en: You're reaching me on the road between Tel Aviv and Jerusalem.
sentences.zh: 我现在在特拉维夫和耶路撒冷之间的路上。

sentences.en: I've spent the last nine hours watching security camera footage from a kibbutz in the south
sentences.zh: 过去九个小时里，我一直在查看南部一个基布兹的监控录像，

sentences.en: called Kibbutz Beri, where more than 100 people were killed on October 7th during the Hamas terrorist attacks.
sentences.zh: 那个基布兹叫贝里，10月7日哈马斯恐怖袭击期间，那里有100多人丧生。

sentences.en: And I've been trying to research exactly what happened that day to try and piece together the events of the day.
sentences.zh: 我一直在试图调查那天到底发生了什么，试图拼凑出当天的事件经过。

sentences.en: And it's been a long few weeks, as it has for everyone here, Israelis and Palestinians.
sentences.zh: 这对这里的每个人，无论是以色列人还是巴勒斯坦人来说，都是漫长的几周。

sentences.en: It has been a long and horrible few weeks.
sentences.zh: 这确实是漫长而可怕的几周。

sentences.en: And I wanted to call you, Patrick, because I wanted to hear what you had to say about the next few weeks, the next phase.
sentences.zh: 我想给你打电话，帕特里克，是因为我想听听你对未来几周、下一阶段的看法。

sentences.en: And the thing that's really been a central focus, I think, for everyone, and certainly in our coverage, has been a ground invasion.
sentences.zh: 我认为，大家关注的焦点，当然也是我们报道的重点，一直是地面入侵。

sentences.en: You know, that was something that we were hearing about really from the very first days after this horrific attack on Israel.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在以色列遭受这次可怕袭击后的最初几天，我们就一直在听到这个消息。

sentences.en: And we keep hearing that it is about to happen and it is imminent.
sentences.zh: 我们不断听到它即将发生，迫在眉睫。

sentences.en: There are currently tens of thousands of troops amassed at the southern border with Gaza.
sentences.zh: 目前有数万名士兵在加沙南部边境集结。

sentences.en: You know, we've had colleagues there, photographers taking photographs of tanks arrayed in fields,
sentences.zh: 我们的同事在那里，摄影师拍摄了田野里部署的坦克照片，

sentences.en: really kind of contributing to this feeling that this thing is about to happen, right?
sentences.zh: 这确实加剧了一种感觉，即这件事即将发生，对吧？

sentences.en: But it hasn't.
sentences.zh: 但它并没有发生。

sentences.en: So let's start to unpack the reasons why.
sentences.zh: 那么，让我们开始分析其中的原因。

sentences.en: Well, one reason why they might be delaying is the fact that there are more than 200 mostly
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们推迟的一个原因可能是现在有200多名主要是以色列的人质

sentences.en: Israeli hostages now in captivity in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 被关押在加沙。

sentences.en: It's believed that most of them are being held underground in Hamas's network of subterranean fortifications.
sentences.zh: 据信，他们中的大多数人被关押在哈马斯地下防御工事网络的深处。

sentences.en: And there are intense negotiations going on, not directly between Hamas and Israel, because they don't have formal relations, but mediated by Qatar and, to some extent, Egypt.
sentences.zh: 目前正在进行激烈的谈判，不是哈马斯和以色列直接谈判，因为他们没有正式关系，而是由卡塔尔和埃及在一定程度上进行调解。

sentences.en: There are talks to try and get some of them out.
sentences.zh: 有谈判试图让其中一些人获释。

sentences.en: And we've already seen four released.
sentences.zh: 我们已经看到四人获释了。

sentences.en: There were two, mother and daughter, released a few days ago.
sentences.zh: 几天前有两人，一对母女获释。

sentences.en: And then yesterday, two elderly women were released to the Egyptians over the border between Egypt and Gaza.
sentences.zh: 然后昨天，两名老妇人在埃及和加沙边境被移交给埃及人。

sentences.en: And there have been reports that maybe there could be 50 more on the way in the coming days.
sentences.zh: 有报道称，未来几天可能还会有50人获释。

sentences.en: Reports of maybe women and children could be released.
sentences.zh: 有报道称妇女和儿童可能会被释放。

sentences.en: None of these have been confirmed.
sentences.zh: 这些都没有得到证实。

sentences.en: But while those negotiations still have a chance of liberating some of the people who've been
sentences.zh: 但在这些谈判仍有机会解救部分被俘人员的同时，

sentences.en: captured, it is thought that Israel is holding back from a grand invasion, lest it harm the chances of winning those people's freedom.
sentences.zh: 人们认为以色列在推迟地面入侵，以免损害这些人重获自由的机会。

sentences.en: And as we know, getting hostages out is pretty complicated.
sentences.zh: 正如我们所知，解救人质非常复杂。

sentences.en: It takes time.
sentences.zh: 这需要时间。

sentences.en: So hostages is one of the reasons for the wait.
sentences.zh: 所以人质是等待的原因之一。

sentences.en: It's one of the factors, but there are others.
sentences.zh: 这是一个因素，但还有其他因素。

sentences.en: One is that if Israel invades Gaza, it is feared that that will then open up a second front with
sentences.zh: 其一是如果以色列入侵加沙，人们担心这会开辟第二条战线，即与

sentences.en: Hezbollah, the Lebanese militia that dominates southern Lebanon, which is allied to Hamas and like Hamas is backed by Iran.
sentences.zh: 黎巴嫩真主党开战，这支黎巴嫩民兵组织统治着黎巴嫩南部，它是哈马斯的盟友，和哈马斯一样由伊朗支持。

sentences.en: So there's a fear that they might get involved even more than they already have done.
sentences.zh: 所以人们担心他们可能会比现在更深地卷入其中。

sentences.en: Then there's the fact that Hamas is very well dug in underneath its stronghold of Gaza City.
sentences.zh: 还有个事实是，哈马斯在加沙城据点下方挖掘得非常深。

sentences.en: It has hundreds of miles of tunnels that it's burrowed away over the last decade and a half.
sentences.zh: 在过去十五年里，他们挖掘了数百英里的隧道。

sentences.en: And it's very hard to get to them there.
sentences.zh: 在那里很难找到他们。

sentences.en: And it's very easy for their fighters to pop up through openings in the ground and ambush the incoming Israeli army.
sentences.zh: 他们的战士很容易从地面的开口处冒出来，伏击进入的以色列军队。

sentences.en: And there's a sense that this could become a kind of urban quagmire, cause huge loss of life to Gazan civilians and to the Israeli ground forces going in and trying to edge their
sentences.zh: 人们有一种感觉，这可能会演变成一种城市泥潭，给加沙平民和进入并试图向哈马斯在加沙城的据点推进的以色列地面部队造成巨大伤亡。

sentences.en: way towards Hamas's stronghold in Gaza City.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，城市向来是出了名的难以攻克，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, cities are notoriously impossible to conquer, right?
sentences.zh: 而加沙是一个人口极其稠密的地方。

sentences.en: And Gaza is this extremely densely populated place.
sentences.zh: 军队进去就会被困住。

sentences.en: Like armies go in, they get stuck.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是美国人在2004年的费卢杰和2016年的摩苏尔北部城市所经历过的。

sentences.en: I mean, this is something that the Americans experienced in Iraq, in Fallujah in 2004 and in the northern city of Mosul in 2016.
sentences.zh: 我知道我们在华盛顿的同事一直在与美国官员交谈。

sentences.en: I know that our colleagues in Washington have been talking to American officials.
sentences.zh: 周二早上的报纸上有一篇大报道，称美国官员实际上非常担心以色列军队没有为此做好准备，

sentences.en: And Tuesday morning in the paper had a big story about how American officials were actually
sentences.zh: 还没有完全意识到这场战斗会有多困难，可能还没有准备好。

sentences.en: quite worried that the Israeli military wasn't prepared for this, hadn't quite taken on board just how difficult this fight would be and might not be ready for it.
sentences.zh: 这在其中起什么作用？

sentences.en: How does that factor in?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为这不仅仅是美国的担忧。

sentences.en: Well, I think that's not only an American concern.
sentences.zh: 以色列国内也有讨论，认为以军需要收集更多关于哈马斯战士和哈马斯防御工事具体位置的情报。

sentences.en: There's talk in Israel that the Israeli army needs to gather more intelligence about exactly where different Hamas fighters and different Hamas fortifications are situated.
sentences.zh: 而且人们觉得以色列也不急于求成。

sentences.en: And there's a sense that also Israel isn't in a rush.
sentences.zh: 它不需要立即冲进去。

sentences.en: It doesn't need to charge in immediately.
sentences.zh: 虽然额外的时间让部队感到紧张，但也给了他们更多训练的时间。

sentences.en: And the extra time, though nerve-wracking for its forces, also gives them more time to train.
sentences.zh: 记住，在加沙边境集结的许多人是应召入伍的预备役军人，有几十万人。

sentences.en: Remember that a lot of the people that are massed on the guards and border are reservists who've been cooled up, several hundred thousand of them.
sentences.zh: 我认为至关重要的是，这给了空军更多时间，试图从空中消灭哈马斯战士和摧毁隧道。

sentences.en: And I think crucially, it gives the Air Force more time to try and take out Hamas fighters and tunnels from the air.
sentences.zh: 有些人认为他们可能正在试图清理某些路线，开辟一条或多条走廊，

sentences.en: There are some who think maybe they're trying to clear certain routes, creating a kind of corridor
sentences.zh: 让他们的部队能够以稍微不那么受阻的路线进入加沙并到达加沙城中心。

sentences.en: or corridors that will allow their troops to enter Gaza and reach the center of Gaza City by a slightly less obstructed route.
sentences.zh: 当然，这里的规划还有另一层含义。

sentences.en: And of course, there's another layer to the planning here.
sentences.zh: 我们也从伊拉克战争中了解到了这一点。

sentences.en: And we also know this from Iraq.
sentences.zh: 当然，问题在于，如果你真的进去了，之后该怎么办？

sentences.en: And that's, of course, the question of, you know, if you do go in, what do you do after that?
sentences.zh: 比如，你真的打算管理它吗？

sentences.en: Like, do you actually try to run it?
sentences.zh: 这是一个价值百万美元的问题。

sentences.en: That's a million-dollar question.
sentences.zh: 因为如果以色列确实重新占领了加沙地带，它将不得不决定是否

sentences.en: Because if and when Israel does retake the Gaza Strip, it's going to have to decide whether
sentences.zh: 想像1967年到2005年那样管理这块飞地，还是想至少名义上将其控制权移交给其他方。

sentences.en: it wants to govern the enclave as it did between 1967 and 2005, or whether it wants to relinquish control of it, at least nominally, to some other party.
sentences.zh: 它不能交给哈马斯。

sentences.en: It can't do that to Hamas.
sentences.zh: 进入的全部意义在于摧毁哈马斯。

sentences.en: The whole point of going in is to destroy Hamas.
sentences.zh: 那么这可能就留给了巴勒斯坦权力机构，即管理被占领的西岸部分地区的巴勒斯坦机构。

sentences.en: And then that probably leaves the Palestinian Authority, which is the Palestinian body that administers parts of the occupied West Bank.
sentences.zh: 但如果这样做，巴勒斯坦权力机构将面临真正的合法性危机，因为

sentences.en: But if it did that, the Palestinian Authority would face a real crisis of legitimacy because
sentences.zh: 许多加沙人会认为它是骑在以色列坦克的背上重返权力的。

sentences.en: it would be perceived by many guards as having rode back to power on the back of an Israeli tank.
sentences.zh: 它可能会发现自己会像2000年代那样迅速失去对该飞地的控制，当时它在2005年至2007年间获得了加沙两年的控制权，随后被哈马斯赶走。

sentences.en: And it may find it would lose control of the enclave as quickly as it did in the 2000s, when it was given control of Gaza for two years between 2005 and 2007, before being forced
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，有人质问题。

sentences.en: out by Hamas.
sentences.zh: 是的，人们担心与黎巴嫩开辟第二战线。

sentences.en: So, yes, there are the hostages.
sentences.zh: 但还有一个大问题，即以色列在占领该领土后将如何处理加沙。

sentences.en: Yes, there are fears of a second front opening up with Lebanon.
sentences.zh: 这是一个艰难的选择。

sentences.en: But also there's the big question of what will Israel do with Gaza after it captures the territory.
sentences.zh: 我们推测，这在一定程度上就是以色列领导人本雅明·内塔尼亚胡总理迟迟不下达入侵命令的原因。

sentences.en: And it's a difficult choice.
sentences.zh: 是的，正如你所说，最终，那个决定，即是否入侵以及随之而来的一切后果，都掌握在一个人手中。

sentences.en: And that is what we presume is partly why Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, the Israeli leader, is taking his time to issue an invasion order.
sentences.zh: 是的，本雅明·内塔尼亚胡。

sentences.en: Yes, as you say, ultimately, that decision, the decision of whether to invade and all of the consequences it brings, rests with one man.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Yes, Benjamin Netanyahu.
sentences.zh: 我是刘文娜（音译）。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我编写了《纽约时报》游戏中的拼图游戏之一《Connections》。

sentences.zh: 我的意思是，最初他当然非常紧迫地宣布要终结哈马斯。

sentences.en: So, Patrick, bring me inside the calculations of Benjamin Netanyahu at this moment.
sentences.zh: 而现在，地面入侵似乎出现了延迟，这是他实现该目标的主要方式之一。

sentences.en: I mean, initially, of course, he declared there would be an end to Hamas with this great urgency.
sentences.zh: 他是如何看待这一切的？

sentences.en: And now there's what appears to be a delay in the ground invasion, one of the principal ways that he would reach that objective.
sentences.zh: 我认为首先要记住的是，从历史上看，他在做重大决定时一直很糟糕。

sentences.en: How does he see all of this?
sentences.zh: 他倾向于推诿、拖延，并试图把事情推到第二天。

sentences.en: I think the first thing to remember is that historically, he's always been quite bad at making big decisions.
sentences.zh: 我们今年在他的国内政策中都看到了这一点，即极具争议的司法改革计划。

sentences.en: He tends to prevaricate and delay and try and push things off until the next day.
sentences.zh: 从来没有人真正确定他的计划到底是什么。

sentences.en: We've seen that all this year with his domestic policies, very controversial plan to overhaul the judiciary.
sentences.zh: 他的计划似乎每天都在变。

sentences.en: No one's ever really been sure what exactly his plan has been.
sentences.zh: 这次计划中的加沙入侵似乎也是如此。

sentences.en: And his plan has seemed to sort of change on a kind of day-by-day basis.
sentences.zh: 但在某种意义上，这算是内塔尼亚胡的标志性风格。

sentences.en: And that also seems to be the case with this planned invasion of Gaza.
sentences.zh: 他把重大决定推迟到最后一刻。

sentences.en: But in a sense, that's sort of Netanyahu's trademark.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是因为这是一个重大决定。

sentences.en: He pushes off big decisions until the very last moment.
sentences.zh: 如果他进去，以色列士兵可能会有巨大的伤亡，就像加沙的普通巴勒斯坦人会有更大的伤亡一样。

sentences.en: And partly that's because it is a big decision.
sentences.zh: 他知道这会给许多以色列人、许多选民带来痛苦。

sentences.en: If he goes in, there could be a big loss of life for Israeli soldiers, just as there will be an even bigger loss of life for ordinary Palestinians in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 这不是他或任何以色列领导人会轻易做出的决定。

sentences.en: And he knows that that will bring pain to a lot of Israelis, a lot of voters.
sentences.zh: 还有另一个因素，一些政治分析人士一直在谈论，那就是10月7日的失败，

sentences.en: And it's not a decision that he or any Israeli leader is going to take lightly.
sentences.zh: 以色列南部军事防御的崩溃，最终在许多人眼中，责任都在他身上。

sentences.en: There's another factor that some political analysts have been talking about, which is that the failure of October the 7th,
sentences.zh: 责任最终由当时的总理承担。

sentences.en: the collapse of the Israeli military defenses in the South, ultimately, in many people's eyes, is on him.
sentences.zh: 他就是主持了那次失败的以色列领导人。

sentences.en: The buck stops with the prime minister of the day.
sentences.zh: 所以，虽然以色列人目前相对团结，因为这是战争，而且他们刚刚经历了10月7日的巨大创伤，

sentences.en: And he is the Israeli leader who presided over that failure.
sentences.zh: 但战后，情况将完全不同。

sentences.en: And so while Israelis are relatively united at the moment, because it's a war and because they've just experienced this huge trauma of October 7th,
sentences.zh: 必然会有全国性的调查。

sentences.en: after the war, it will be a completely different case.
sentences.zh: 这对负责人来说可能不会是什么好事。

sentences.en: There's bound to be a national inquiry.
sentences.zh: 这包括内塔尼亚胡。

sentences.en: And that probably isn't going to look good for the people who are in charge.
sentences.zh: 这可能会导致他的政府垮台。

sentences.en: And that includes Netanyahu.
sentences.zh: 那将导致新的选举。

sentences.en: It could collapse his government.
sentences.zh: 如果当前局势保持不变，那么他将难以赢得那场选举，他将失去权力。

sentences.en: That would then lead to a new election.
sentences.zh: 所以有些人认为他不急于开始地面入侵，因为入侵开始得越早，战争结束得就越早。

sentences.en: And if the current situation remains the same, then he would struggle to win that election and he'd be out of power.
sentences.zh: 战争结束得越早，他的政治权力受到威胁的可能性就越大。

sentences.en: So there are some people who think that he's in no rush to start a ground invasion because the sooner the invasion begins, the sooner the war ends.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，你知道，这个决定对内塔尼亚胡来说也是一个政治决定。

sentences.en: And the sooner the war ends, the likelier it is that there will be a threat to his political power.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这可能关乎他的政治生存。

sentences.en: So in other words, you know, the decision is also a political one for Netanyahu.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, potentially a matter of his political survival.
sentences.zh: 这也是他热衷于将反对派成员纳入政府的部分原因。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 几周前，他组建了一个团结政府，引入了一些中间派反对派成员，

sentences.en: And that's partly why he was keen to bring in members of the opposition into his government.
sentences.zh: 包括两名前高级将领，这给了他的内阁更多的经验和更多的军事分量。

sentences.en: A couple of weeks ago, he formed a unity government, bringing in some members of the centrist opposition,
sentences.zh: 几周前，他组建了一个联合政府，吸纳了一些中间派反对党成员，

sentences.en: including two former senior generals that gave his cabinet more experience, more military heft.
sentences.zh: 其中包括两位前高级将领，这让他的内阁更有经验，也更有军事分量。

sentences.en: But it also meant that he can spread responsibility.
sentences.zh: 但这同时也意味着他可以分摊责任。

sentences.en: Whatever happens now is not just going to be on him.
sentences.zh: 无论接下来发生什么，都不会只由他一个人承担。

sentences.en: It'll also be on those two generals who he brought into his war cabinet.
sentences.zh: 这也将由他请进战时内阁的那两位将军共同承担。

sentences.en: And that's both a security-minded decision, but it's also being construed by some analysts as a very political decision
sentences.zh: 这既是一个出于安全考虑的决定，也被一些分析人士解读为一个非常政治化的决定，

sentences.en: because after the war and when assessments are made of how the war went, he won't be alone on the stage in front of critics who will be analyzing his performance.
sentences.zh: 因为在战争结束后，当人们评估战争进程时，他将不会独自站在批评者面前，面对他们对其表现的剖析。

sentences.en: And Patrick, what is the public sentiment here?
sentences.zh: 帕特里克，这里的公众情绪如何？

sentences.en: I mean, is there a chomping at the bit to invade?
sentences.zh: 我是说，大家是否迫不及待地想要发动入侵？

sentences.en: How does the Israeli public see this?
sentences.zh: 以色列公众对此有何看法？

sentences.en: I think the bottom line is this polling shows that a majority of Israelis do support a ground invasion.
sentences.zh: 我认为底线是，民调显示大多数以色列人确实支持地面入侵。

sentences.en: And there's a sense that after what Hamas did on October 7th, there's no way that Israel could really countenance keeping a Senate's leadership on their doorstep.
sentences.zh: 人们有一种感觉，在哈马斯10月7日的所作所为之后，以色列绝不可能容忍家门口还留着这样一个领导层。

sentences.en: But underneath that headline, there's a lot of nuance.
sentences.zh: 但在这一标题之下，还有很多细微差别。

sentences.en: For a start, there's a small and not particularly vocal minority that doesn't want to invade at all.
sentences.zh: 首先，有一小部分人并不怎么发声，他们根本不想入侵。

sentences.en: And even among the people that do want an invasion, there are a mixture of positions.
sentences.zh: 即使在那些支持入侵的人中，立场也各不相同。

sentences.en: There are certainly those that sound very vengeful.
sentences.zh: 当然有人听起来非常渴望复仇。

sentences.en: There are people on the far right who are calling for the expulsion of all Palestinians from Gaza.
sentences.zh: 极右翼人士呼吁将所有巴勒斯坦人赶出加沙。

sentences.en: But then there's also probably a much bigger group that just wants to get rid of Hamas and is wary of the pain and loss that a ground invasion will bring.
sentences.zh: 但可能还有更大一部分人只是想除掉哈马斯，他们对地面入侵将带来的痛苦和损失心存顾虑。

sentences.en: It will be bloody.
sentences.zh: 这将是血腥的。

sentences.en: It will likely involve great loss of life, mostly on the Palestinian side, but also for the Israeli soldiers.
sentences.zh: 这很可能涉及巨大的生命损失，主要是巴勒斯坦方面，但以色列士兵也会有伤亡。

sentences.en: And all across Israel, there are families, probably the majority of families, that have someone who is at the front or preparing to go to the front.
sentences.zh: 在整个以色列，有许多家庭，可能占大多数，都有亲人在前线或准备前往前线。

sentences.en: And those families know that their loved one might not make it back.
sentences.zh: 这些家庭知道，他们的亲人可能无法活着回来。

sentences.en: And so the whole conversation about an invasion is tinged with a sense of necessity, but also a sense of anxiety and danger.
sentences.zh: 因此，关于入侵的整个讨论都带有一种必要感，但也夹杂着焦虑和危险感。

sentences.en: And in the meantime, the Israelis have launched this relentless series of airstrikes over Gaza.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，以色列人对加沙发动了一系列无情的空袭。

sentences.en: You've been reporting on that.
sentences.zh: 你一直在报道这些情况。

sentences.en: Tell us what you're learning, Patrick.
sentences.zh: 告诉我们你了解到的情况，帕特里克。

sentences.en: What are you hearing in your reporting?
sentences.zh: 你在报道中听到了什么？

sentences.en: I think the bottom line is it's the most intense Israeli bombing campaign on Gaza ever.
sentences.zh: 我认为底线是，这是以色列对加沙有史以来最猛烈的轰炸行动。

sentences.en: The military said today that they had hit 7,000 targets in Gaza in just over two and a half weeks.
sentences.zh: 军方今天表示，他们在短短两周半多一点的时间里，打击了加沙的7000个目标。

sentences.en: Wow, 7,000 targets.
sentences.zh: 哇，7000个目标。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the Hamas-run health ministry in Gaza said yesterday that nearly 6,000 people had died during that bombing campaign.
sentences.zh: 哈马斯管理的加沙卫生部昨天表示，在这次轰炸行动中，已有近6000人死亡。

sentences.en: That isn't a figure that we've been able to verify, but if it's anything close to it, then it's quite a staggering number.
sentences.zh: 我们无法核实这个数字，但如果接近事实，那将是一个惊人的数字。

sentences.en: The whole neighborhoods have been leveled, including in the wealthier parts of Gaza City,
sentences.zh: 整个街区都被夷为平地，包括加沙城较富裕的地区，

sentences.en: areas that typically have not been damaged or only lightly damaged in previous rounds of conflict between Hamas and Israel.
sentences.zh: 这些地区在以往哈马斯与以色列的冲突中通常没有受损，或者仅受到轻微损坏。

sentences.en: Israel says that it only targets militants and military infrastructure and that any civilian loss of life is because the militants, Hamas,
sentences.zh: 以色列称其只针对武装分子和军事基础设施，任何平民伤亡都是因为武装分子，即哈马斯，

sentences.en: borrow themselves into civilian areas in order to give themselves human shields.
sentences.zh: 躲藏在平民区，以此作为人肉盾牌。

sentences.en: But to Palestinians, the bombing campaign,
sentences.zh: 但对巴勒斯坦人来说，这次轰炸行动，

sentences.en: Israel's bombing campaign feels like it's targeting civilians themselves because there has been such a high death toll across civil society, medical workers killed,
sentences.zh: 以色列的轰炸行动感觉就像是在针对平民本身，因为整个民间社会伤亡惨重，医务人员被杀，

sentences.en: journalists killed, bombs on marketplaces, mosques, and so on.
sentences.zh: 记者被杀，集市、清真寺等地遭到轰炸，等等。

sentences.en: And coupled with that is a rising humanitarian crisis that has been set off by Israel's siege of Gaza.
sentences.zh: 随之而来的是以色列对加沙的围困所引发的日益严重的人道主义危机。

sentences.en: It's cut off water.
sentences.zh: 它切断了水供应。

sentences.en: It's cut off electricity.
sentences.zh: 它切断了电力。

sentences.en: It's cut off almost all food supplies.
sentences.zh: 它切断了几乎所有的食物供应。

sentences.en: And it's encouraged hundreds of thousands of Gazans to move from the north of the Strip to the south, which means that southern Gaza is very, very overcrowded.
sentences.zh: 它还鼓励数十万加沙人从加沙地带北部向南部迁移，这意味着加沙南部非常、非常拥挤。

sentences.en: People are scavenging, essentially, every day to find food and mortar.
sentences.zh: 人们基本上每天都在为寻找食物和必需品而挣扎。

sentences.en: And life's become extremely difficult for Palestinians in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 加沙巴勒斯坦人的生活变得极其艰难。

sentences.en: Not that it was easy before the war, but it's been taken to another level now.
sentences.zh: 并不是说战前生活就很容易，但现在情况已经到了另一个层面。

sentences.en: So, Patrick, is there a risk here, you know, with the civilian casualties mounting and this deepening humanitarian crisis in Gaza,
sentences.zh: 那么，帕特里克，这里是否存在一种风险，你知道，随着平民伤亡的增加和加沙人道主义危机的加深，

sentences.en: that the longer the airstrikes continue, the more Israel risks losing support for its ground offensive?
sentences.zh: 空袭持续的时间越长，以色列失去对其地面攻势支持的风险就越大？

sentences.en: I think that's about right.
sentences.zh: 我想大概是这样。

sentences.en: But in the opening days of this particular conflict, Israel had just experienced what its president has called the bloodiest day for Jews since the HolocauSt.
sentences.zh: 但在这次冲突的初期，以色列刚刚经历了其总统所说的自大屠杀以来犹太人最血腥的一天。

sentences.en: And it felt like there was broad global support, particularly from leaders, if not citizens,
sentences.zh: 当时似乎有广泛的全球支持，特别是来自各国领导人，如果不是来自各国公民的话，

sentences.en: for Israel taking essentially defensive action against the group that had enacted all these massacres in southern Israel.
sentences.zh: 支持以色列对在以色列南部制造了所有这些大屠杀的组织采取本质上的防御行动。

sentences.en: But as time's gone on and the air rates have increased and the loss of life in Gaza has grown and grown,
sentences.zh: 但随着时间的推移，空袭加剧，加沙的生命损失不断增加，

sentences.en: and the narrative has shifted away from the villages that were raided in southern Israel early this month
sentences.zh: 叙事也从本月初遭到袭击的以色列南部村庄，

sentences.en: to the crowded urban areas of Gaza where thousands of Palestinians have been killed in bomb strikes.
sentences.zh: 转向了加沙拥挤的城市地区，那里有数千名巴勒斯坦人在轰炸中丧生。

sentences.en: But as a result, you're starting to see different measures come out from global leaders,
sentences.zh: 结果，你开始看到全球领导人采取了不同的措施，

sentences.en: one in which they talk about Israel needing to respect international law, avoiding loss of civilian life.
sentences.zh: 他们谈论以色列需要尊重国际法，避免平民生命损失。

sentences.en: You're not quite seeing Western leaders coming out strongly against an invasion in and of itself,
sentences.zh: 你并没有看到西方领导人强烈反对入侵本身，

sentences.en: but there seem to be more qualifiers and qualifications attached to the West's expression of support for Israel.
sentences.zh: 但西方对以色列的支持表达中似乎附加了更多的限定条件。

sentences.en: And that rhetorical shift may accelerate and morph into something stronger, for example, an outright rejection of an Israeli invasion of Gaza.
sentences.zh: 这种言辞上的转变可能会加速并演变成更强硬的东西，例如，彻底拒绝以色列入侵加沙。

sentences.en: So, Patrick, there have been a lot of comparisons in recent days to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么，帕特里克，最近几天有很多关于美国在9-11事件后的比较，

sentences.en: after 9-11 and, you know, this idea that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这种观点认为美国在袭击后处于愤怒和情绪的迷雾中，

sentences.en: was in this fog of anger and emotion after the attack and made some real strategic errors in the wake of it, namely invading Iraq.
sentences.zh: 并在随后的行动中犯下了一些真正的战略错误，即入侵伊拉克。

sentences.en: Has this come up at all in your reporting as you're talking to Israelis, people in the government, Israeli citizens?
sentences.zh: 在你与以色列人、政府官员、以色列公民交谈时，这在你的报道中出现过吗？

sentences.en: Is anybody talking about Israel and how it might be about to make a strategic mistake if it does this ground invasion?
sentences.zh: 有没有人在谈论以色列，以及如果它进行这次地面入侵，是否可能即将犯下战略错误？

sentences.en: I think that the 9-11 comparison has been made frequently both in Israel and outside.
sentences.zh: 我认为9-11的比较在以色列内外都被频繁提及。

sentences.en: And to begin with, I think Israelis thought it was a useful comparison to make because by comparing it to 9-11, they could convey to the world just what a big deal it was
sentences.zh: 起初，我认为以色列人认为这是一个有用的比较，因为通过将其与9-11进行比较，他们可以向世界传达恐怖分子前来屠杀约1400名以色列人（其中许多人在家中被杀）是一件多么重大的事情。

sentences.en: for terrorists to come and slaughter around 1,400 Israelis, many of them in their homes.
sentences.zh: 但随着时间的推移，它有了双重含义，因为正如你所说，也正如乔·拜登所说，美国在9-11事件后在情绪冲动下所做的事情，

sentences.en: But as time's gone on, it's taken on a double meaning because, as you say, and as Joe Biden has said, what America did in the aftermath of 9-11 in the heat of its emotion
sentences.zh: 并不一定是最明智的，包括入侵伊拉克以及后来陷入的泥潭。

sentences.en: was not necessarily the wisest, including the invasion of Iraq and the quagmire that that became.
sentences.zh: 当然，以色列内外有很多人承认，在冲动之下做决定并不是最好的计划。

sentences.en: And certainly there are plenty of people in Israel and outside who acknowledge that making decisions in the heat of the moment is not the best plan.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，其他人说，等等，伊拉克距离美国有数千英里，

sentences.en: But at the same time, other people say, well, hang on, Iraq was thousands of miles away from
sentences.zh: 但加沙就在以色列的家门口，它没有不认真对待哈马斯威胁的余地。

sentences.en: America, but Gaza is right on Israel's doorstep and it doesn't have the luxury of not taking the threat of Hamas seriously.
sentences.zh: 它必须采取行动。

sentences.en: It has to do something.
sentences.zh: 对哈马斯的所作所为做出反应远非不理智和情绪化，实际上，试图清除这个刚刚在以色列南部制造了这些血腥大屠杀的组织，是最合乎逻辑的事情。

sentences.en: And far from being irrational and emotional to respond to what Hamas has done, it's actually the most logical thing to try to remove this organization that just led
sentences.zh: 还有另一群人看得更远，他们不仅关注铲除哈马斯之后会发生什么。

sentences.en: these bloody massacres in southern Israel.
sentences.zh: 他们说，除掉哈马斯固然很好。

sentences.en: And then there's another group of people that zoom out even further and they're looking beyond what happens if you root out Hamas.
sentences.zh: 但如果你没有一个更广泛的计划，不仅是关于谁来管理加沙，还有如何处理以色列-巴勒斯坦冲突，如何解决导致这场冲突的长期挑战和失衡，

sentences.en: And they're saying it's all very well to get rid of Hamas.
sentences.zh: 那么在未来的某个时间点，只会再次发生爆炸，重蹈覆辙，循环往复。

sentences.en: But if you don't have a wider plan, not just for who runs Gaza, but what to do about the
sentences.zh: 那么，帕特里克，根据你所说的一切，如果以色列继续进行地面入侵，当然会有巨大的风险。

sentences.en: Israeli-Palestinian conflict, how to address the long running challenges and imbalances that
sentences.zh: 但如果以色列在推迟的同时继续这些空袭，也会造成巨大的人员伤亡。

sentences.en: have created this conflict, then a certain point down the line, there's going to be just another explosion and a repeat and the cycle will go on and on.
sentences.zh: 但我们在这里没有讨论的第三种方式，即直接取消入侵，是否存在？

sentences.en: So, Patrick, from everything you've said, there are, of course, enormous risks if Israel goes ahead with a ground invasion.
sentences.zh: 我们是否有可能朝着这个方向发展，即地面入侵可能根本不会发生？

sentences.en: But there's also an enormous human toll if Israel continues with these airstrikes while they delay.
sentences.zh: 这总是有可能的。

sentences.en: But is there also a third way that we're not talking about here, which is just calling it off?
sentences.zh: 人们表达这种建议的声音比几天前稍微多了一些。

sentences.en: Is there any chance that that's where we're headed, that a ground invasion may not happen at all?
sentences.zh: 但我认为，如果以色列不发动地面入侵，许多以色列人会将其视为向一个在一天之内杀害了1400名以色列人的组织投降，

sentences.en: It's always possible.
sentences.zh: 这会开创一个坏先例，使以色列显得软弱，并会导致他们失去巨大的信心。

sentences.en: And people are voicing that suggestion a little bit more vocally than they were a few days ago.
sentences.zh: 因此，以色列不会对如此规模的事件做出反应，只会取消地面入侵，让制造那场大屠杀的组织留在其家门口，这种想法让人觉得有点难以置信。

sentences.en: But I think if Israel didn't launch a ground invasion, many Israelis would see that as a capitulation to a group that's just killed 1,400 Israelis in a single
sentences.zh: 那么这是否意味着我们将在这个状态下持续一段时间？

sentences.en: day that sets a bad precedent that makes Israel seem weak and would cause them a massive loss of faith.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在这些空袭看不到尽头的情况下，预料着地面入侵？

sentences.en: So the idea that Israel would not respond to something of that magnitude and would just call off a ground invasion and let the group that perpetrates that massacre remain on
sentences.zh: 嗯，一切皆有可能。

sentences.en: its doorstep feels a little bit hard to believe.
sentences.zh: 但我们这些在实地的报道者当然不会很快撤离。

sentences.en: So does this mean we're going to be in this place for a while?
sentences.zh: 帕特里克，我听不到你身后汽车的声音。

sentences.en: You know, anticipating a ground invasion with really no end in sight of these airstrikes?
sentences.zh: 你到家了。

sentences.en: Well, anything's possible.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: But us reported on the ground certainly aren't standing down anytime soon ourselves.
sentences.zh: 我到家了，正期待着上床睡觉。

sentences.en: Patrick, I don't hear the sound of the car behind you.
sentences.zh: 那我就不打扰你了。

sentences.en: You're home.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你，帕特里克，接受我的采访。

sentences.en: Yes, that's right.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: I am home and I'm looking forward to going to bed.
sentences.zh: 回头聊。

sentences.en: I'm going to let you go to do that.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Thank you so much, Patrick, for talking to me.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还应该知道的消息。

sentences.en: Thank you, Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 第三位试图帮助唐纳德·特朗普推翻2020年选举结果的律师在佐治亚州的敲诈勒索案中认罪，并同意与正在针对特朗普进行调查的检察官合作。

sentences.en: Speak soon.
sentences.zh: 这位律师珍娜·埃利斯现在加入了西德尼·鲍威尔和肯尼斯·切斯布罗的行列，倒戈反对特朗普。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 在向法庭发表的充满泪水的声明中，埃利斯表示，她对自己参与特朗普窃取选举的竞选活动感到后悔。

sentences.en: Here's what else you should know today.
sentences.zh: 如果我当时知道我现在所知道的一切，我就不会拒绝在这些选举后的挑战中代表唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: A third lawyer who tried to help Donald Trump overturn the results of the 2020 election has pleaded guilty in a Georgia racketeering case and agreed to
sentences.zh: 我带着深深的悔意回顾整个经历。
